name: Hotel Kleon
beschreibung: The Hotel Kleon is located in the municipality of Jerzens in the Pitztal in Tirol. The Ötztaler Alpen shape the surroundings and offer hiking trails in summer as well as the Hochzeiger ski area in winter. The property is kept in an alpine style and offers a quiet atmosphere. Amenities include a wellness area with sauna and steam bath as well as a restaurant. Guests can take part in guided tours or explore the surroundings on their own. The connection to the ski area is provided by a ski bus.
